source.title: New WCAT Leader (January 2020)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Committee Leader. **Wilson Alvis** will become the new Leader of the **WCA Competition Announcement Team** (WCAT). 

Wilson was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote among the current Committee Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our [Motion 10.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams.

We thank Henrik for the work he has done as the leader for the WCAT, and wish Wilson Alvis best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

The new Leader has already been already promoted. Wilson Alvis was among the two applicants who applied and the candidacy documents can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/open?id=1MrEB9E7E8hh0axrXZ6uiU3PdbD-767sV) if you are interested in viewing them.

translation.title: WCA 比赛公示组新负责人（2020 年 1 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，**Wilson Alvis** 将担任 **WCA 比赛公示组（WCAT）**的新负责人。

按照关于 WCA 委员会和团队的 [10.2019.0 号议案](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节，WCA 董事会选定 Wilson，并经现任委员会负责人和高级代表投票批准。

感谢 Henrik 在担任 WCAT 负责人期间所做的工作，祝 Wilson Alvis 履新顺利。

新负责人的任命已生效。本次共有两位申请人，Wilson Alvis 是其中之一。如有兴趣，可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/open?id=1MrEB9E7E8hh0axrXZ6uiU3PdbD-767sV)查看申请材料。
